about: Product-options storefront fields, shared byte for byte by teleport-gui (apps/gui/app/project-page/features/e-commerce/utils/product-options/__tests__/fixtures/product-options-storefront.fixture.json, run through packages/renderer/src/utils/ecommerce-products.ts) and teleport-code-generators (packages/teleport-plugin-next-data-source/__tests__/product-options-storefront.fixture.json, run through the generated product transform). Each case is a raw product row, its variant combinations (null = not looked up), the storefront tax rate, the request language and whether the product is the details page's single product; expected holds every product-options field both transforms must emit. Change both copies together.
